by_class = recent.groupby('cls').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'count'
}).reset_index()
by_class['yt_per_angler'] = by_class['yt'] / by_class['anglers']
by_class.columns = ['class', 'total_yt', 'total_anglers', 'trips', 'yt_per_angler']
